summary.name: qutebrowser
summary.one_liner: qutebrowser is a free, GPL-licensed, keyboard-focused web browser with a minimal GUI and vim-like key bindings, built on Python and Qt.
use_cases: browsing the web with keyboard shortcuts
vim-style navigation in a web browser
reporting bugs or requesting features in an open-source project
using an adblocker with ABP syntax
summary.what_it_does: qutebrowser is a keyboard-focused browser with a minimal graphical interface, written in Python and based on Qt. It is inspired by dwb and Vimperator/Pentadactyl. The default rendering backend is QtWebEngine (based on Chromium), with QtWebKit listed as an alternative that the page does not recommend. It can optionally use pdf.js to display PDF files, and supports optional adblocking with ABP syntax via the adblock library. The page also lists built-in commands such as :report for filing bug reports.
notable: Vim-like, keyboard-driven interface with a minimal GUI
Built on Python and Qt, with QtWebEngine (Chromium) as the default backend
Optional pdf.js PDF viewing and ABP-syntax adblocking
Free software licensed under GPL v3
caveats: Requires Python 3.10+ and Qt 6.2.0+ or 5.15.0+ with PyQt, plus several Qt modules
QtWebKit backend is not recommended due to known unpatched security issues
Primary maintainer works part-time and relies on donations
